problems.title: Bracket Ledger
problems.statement: A clerk writes entries using three kinds of brackets: ( ), [ ] and { }. An entry is balanced when every bracket is closed by the matching kind in the correct nesting order. Decide whether the entry is balanced.
problems.inputFormat: A single line containing 1 to 100000 bracket characters.

problems.title: Steady Streak
problems.statement: A sensor logs n integer readings. A streak is a run of consecutive readings that are all equal. Report the length of the longest streak.
problems.inputFormat: Line 1: n. Line 2: n integers separated by spaces.
problems.outputFormat: One integer: the longest streak length.
